Independent research reproduction · arXiv:2608.07536v1

Yield-curve reproduction

Original Treasury zero-coupon data, macro predictors, and direct versus factor forecasts.

Completed: 50 trees per forest

14 competing models + random walk · 4 horizons · 13 targets · 780 metric rows

Scope: The paper uses 500 trees. The supplied run uses 50. Data and baseline AR forecasts match at displayed precision; ML and trading results are independent reconstructions with documented assumptions.

PSO forecasts did not replicate. The time-varying model's forecasting errors are substantially larger than the paper reports, despite close curve fits. The primary run uses the unscaled objective and stated local tolerances. Unspecified optimizer settings and unstable factor identification remain unresolved.

Trading reconstruction

The exercise prices synthetic zero-coupon bonds at entry and their shorter remaining maturities at exit. Slope positions are DV01-neutral at entry and gross-value normalized. Costs are one basis point each way. Signal scaling uses 24 pre-evaluation months.

Longer-horizon holding periods overlap. Annualized returns below are arithmetic mean holding-period returns multiplied by 12/h; they are not a compounded wealth path. The paper does not fully specify its capital normalization, so these trading numbers are not claimed to reproduce its tables.

Why exact ML reproduction remains unresolved

  • The stated ten maturities create 60 yield predictors; Table 4 reports 90 without identifying the other series.
  • Appendix A contains 125 codes but the text says 123. Two listed codes do not occur in the source files; those exclusions are logged.
  • The macro vintage, missing-value treatment, random seeds, pooled-PSO tuning, and several backtest conventions are unspecified.
  • Appendix A's codes 3/6/7 differ from official FRED-MD transformations. Both conventions are implemented. Revised-data publication lags do not remove revision look-ahead.

The full choices and their justification are in references/REPRODUCTION_DECISIONS.md. Original inputs, configuration, package versions, source hashes, and training dates are retained.

Run the 500-tree experiment

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python run.py --config configs/full_500_trees.json --output results/full_500 --workers 8
python make_report.py --results results/full_500

The full settings can take several hours. Each completed model/horizon job is checkpointed. Scientific checks cover factor recovery, forecast-label availability, publication lags, training-only imputation, transformation differences, HAC lag selection, bond ageing, and hedge neutrality.

Use reproduction.ipynb to explore the supplied tables. Each experiment has separate numerical forecasts, model comparisons, feature importances, trading diagnostics, and a provenance manifest.

Paper · Original yield data · FRED-MD · Independent implementation, prepared 13 October 2026 UTC.
